div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Notes:
1) Only confirmed registrations appear in this list - waitlisted and
pending registrations are never shown, so they can never be checked in.
2) A check-in is rejected when the ticket is already used or the
registration is not confirmed; in that case nothing is recorded.
3) Online events: opening the meeting link records attendance
automatically (idempotent) - a separate automatic path.
